comments.body:
OSS consensus audit (2026-08-13): APPROVED investigation-and-optimization pattern; implementation must remain conditional on the profile's specific mechanism.

Git's own bulk-import backend consumes one mixed stream and writes packfiles/refs in bulk rather than invoking repository writes record-by-record (git/git@745601a, Documentation/git-fast-import.adoc#L14-L29). That supports amortizing redundant repository work, but not blindly replacing rebar's safety semantics with git fast-import. The accepted rebar contract on left-changeful-mamba remains controlling: N=3000, 6,000 events, exactly 24 crash-safe commits, >=10x reduction.

Tracker cross-check: left-changeful-mamba requires those exact assertions; no ticket rejected removing redundant scans/serialization inside the existing batch boundary. Proceed by profiling first, then implement only a narrow, measured bulk-path optimization that preserves crash-resume/rollback and all platform coverage. If the profile points to a semantic tradeoff rather than redundant work, stop and report it.

RED evidence and discriminating runtime proof.

Full origin/main cProfile of the unchanged N=3000 real-git integration node: import_tickets 89.607s cumulative; 6,000 append_event calls; author -> _git_config 6,001 times / 47.790s; batch staging 3,000 CREATEs invoked sweep_stale_staging 3,000 times / 15.938s with 375,876 owner checks. Total pytest call time 90.033s (the profiler process later spent 52.6s deleting old pytest temp trees, excluded from importer attribution).

Identical-harness controlled A/B retained 3,000 creates, 3,000 comments and 29 total commits (5 init + locked 24 import delta): real counted collaborators 77.231s with 6,001 git-config wrapper calls / 3,000 sweeps; replacing only those collaborators with side-effect-free logical equivalents 16.404s, same state/commits. Delta: -60.827s (-78.8%), discriminating these two mechanisms from serialization/commit-count alternatives.

Final held-out RED oracle strengthens the existing N=3000 node without timing assertions. All original state/count/24-commit assertions passed, then the new collaborator tuple failed exactly as predicted: expected (author=1, sweeps=12), got (author=6000, sweeps=3000). The test was removed from the fixer-visible tree before implementation and is held by the orchestrator.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Final rebar-debug report (pre-Gerrit).

Problem: the locked N=3000 importer integration test consumed 77-90s locally while preserving 3,000 creates, 3,000 comments and 24 import commits.

Proven root cause: the bulk path performed 6,000 subprocess-backed user.name lookups and 3,000 whole-staging-root stale sweeps. Full cProfile attributed 47.790s to 6,001 _git_config calls and 15.938s to the sweeps; controlled identical-state A/B removed 60.827s (78.8%) by replacing only those collaborators.

Test/proof: tests/interfaces/io/test_import_batch_resume.py was strengthened as the physically held-out RED oracle. Before the fix its unchanged state/commit assertions passed and collaborator counts failed (6000, 3000) vs (1, 12). After the held-out fix it passed at 17.76-19.14s. Independent defect mutations returned RED: no author scope => (6000, 12), 72.34s; per-item sweep => (1, 3000), 33.51s. A copied-context isolation oracle then exposed mutable ContextVar sharing (copied miss leaked copied-1 into the parent); copy-on-write made it GREEN, and restoring mutation returned RED.

Fix: explicit import-scoped, fallback-keyed, copy-on-write author caching plus at most one stale-staging sweep for the first new ticket in each bounded batch. Direct/interactive callers retain live lookup and sweep defaults. No dependency, external effect, durability rule, event content, commit-count rule, or coverage was removed.

Replication: same-host N=3000 reproduction completed in 17.040s with 3,000 CREATE + 3,000 COMMENT files, exactly 24 commits, one user.name read, 12 stale sweeps, clean index, and an idempotent zero-write rerun. Compared with counted baseline 77.231s, wall time fell 60.191s (77.9%); author reads fell 6,000x and sweeps 250x.

Safety: 52 focused import/store tests passed in 67.56s; lint, format, complexity, actionlint/zizmor, and mypy passed. Full default selection under xdist: 12,841 passed, 52 skipped; sole failure is pre-existing origin/main src/rebar/_config_schema.py at 808 LOC against the 800 cap, unrelated to this diff and already covered by cinderlike-lucky-akitainu. No test was weakened.

Caller/sibling sweep: single writes, reconciler stage_event callers, claim/close/delete and ordinary event writes retain defaults/live behavior; no additional production sibling needed a change. CLI/library/import surfaces converge on the same importer/core, so no parity gap. Residual risk: repo-wide size headroom remains tracked on cinderlike-lucky-akitainu; accepted as outside this latency change.

compiled_state.description:
## Context and confirmed root cause

The accepted benchmark on closed ticket left-changeful-mamba deliberately requires 3,000 tickets, 6,000 events, exactly 24 batched commits, and >=10x commit-count reduction. It is the integration-tier long pole at 93-108s on current macOS jobs. N, event count, commit/crash safety, platform cells, and coverage are locked.

A full N=3000 cProfile on current origin/main confirmed two dynamic bulk-path defects:
- rebar._commands._seam.append_event calls author(), which executes git config user.name once per envelope. The benchmark made 6,000 calls; _git_config consumed 47.79s cumulative and subprocess.run 59.54s.
- event_append.batch_stage_and_commit prepares a chunk by calling staging.stage_event for every not-yet-published CREATE. stage_event calls sweep_stale_staging for each new ticket, so the benchmark made 3,000 sweeps and 375,876 staging-owner checks, consuming 15.94s. Within a batch, the same staging root is rescanned while earlier prepared items remain unpublished.

Controlled identical-harness A/B, preserving 3,000 creates, 3,000 comments, and 29 total commits (5 init + the locked 24 import delta):
- current collaborators with counting wrappers: 77.231s, 6,001 git-config reads, 3,000 sweeps;
- only git-config and sweep replaced by side-effect-free logical collaborators: 16.404s, same state and commits.
That 60.8s delta discriminates these mechanisms from event serialization/commit count as the dominant avoidable cost.

## OSS comparison and prior decisions

Git's maintained fast-import backend reads one stream and writes repository objects/refs in bulk (git/git@745601a, Documentation/git-fast-import.adoc#L14-L29). The relevant consensus is amortizing repeat setup/scans inside a bulk boundary, not replacing rebar's event validation or crash-safe commits with git fast-import.

Tracker cross-check: left-changeful-mamba locks N=3000, 6,000 events, 24 commits, >=10x reduction, rollback, and crash-resume. coercive-paediatric-bug rejects extra workers/shards that increase runner-minutes. No ticket rejects batch-scoped identity lookup or one stale-staging sweep per batch; interactive per-write behavior remains unchanged.

## Plan

1. In src/rebar/_commands/_seam.py add an explicit contextvar-scoped author cache. Outside that context author() retains the existing per-call git-config read. The cache is keyed by fallback so git-config-less Unknown/unknown parity remains. It is nestable and reset in finally. Do not extend the existing module-global _ATTRIBUTION_CACHE: that cache owns user.email/identity invalidation across independent writes, whereas user.name must remain live for independent interactive writes and be frozen only inside one explicit import context. Document the distinct lifetimes beside both caches.
2. In src/rebar/_io/import_ndjson.py enter that author-cache context for the whole import composition. Every imported envelope therefore uses the author value observed once at import start; no cache survives the call, thread/task, or pytest session. Event bytes and attribution fields are otherwise unchanged.
3. In src/rebar/_store/staging.py add a keyword-only sweep_stale=True parameter to stage_event. The default preserves every direct/reconciler caller. In src/rebar/_store/event_prepare.py thread the same defaulted parameter through _prepare_event; stage_and_commit keeps the default.
4. In src/rebar/_store/event_append.py keep streaming validation/preparation and a local swept_stale flag. For each item call _prepare_event(..., sweep_stale=not swept_stale); after the first returned StagedEvent has staging_dir set (proving the validated item took the new-ticket branch and performed the sweep), set swept_stale=True for the rest of that bounded batch. Thus empty and existing-ticket-only batches add no sweep, a new-ticket batch sweeps exactly once, invalid input still fails before any new sweep, and materialization/generator semantics remain unchanged. Atomic staging/publish, rollback, lock, and commit behavior remain unchanged.
5. Strengthen the existing N=3000 integration benchmark with deterministic counters: one user.name lookup for the import and one stale sweep per CREATE chunk; derive the expected count from the already-computed locked import commit formula (expected / 2), not a second hardcoded chunk-size literal, never wall-clock thresholds. Add focused unit coverage that empty batches do not sweep, existing-ticket-only batches do not introduce a new sweep, new-ticket batches sweep once, direct stage_event still sweeps, fallback-sensitive author caching is scoped, and interactive writes remain uncached.
6. RED first on the current mechanisms, hold the oracle out from the fixer, then GREEN. Re-seed each defect independently (remove author cache; restore per-item sweep) and prove the corresponding assertion returns RED. Refactoring-only renames must remain green.
7. Re-run the identical N=3000 harness/profile on the same host and report wall/call-count deltas. Run import batching/idempotency/crash-resume/rollback, atomic ticket-dir/store tests, lint, typecheck, and the full pytest selection.

## Test contract card

authoritative_contract: left-changeful-mamba plus tests/interfaces/io/test_import_batch_resume.py require N=3000, 6,000 events, exactly 24 crash-safe commits, >=10x reduction, complete created/comment counts, rollback and resume; this ticket requires eliminating redundant bulk setup without changing those contracts.
trigger_preconditions: a fresh git-backed store importing 3,000 synthetic CREATE+comment records through public rebar.import_tickets.
production_path: rebar.import_tickets -> import_ndjson.import_tickets -> _seam.append_event/finalize_event -> event_append.batch_stage_and_commit -> event_prepare._prepare_event -> staging.stage_event.
test_tier: real temporary-git integration for the locked import contract plus focused unit tests for cache/sweep lifecycle.
observable_postcondition: identical logical state and 24 import commits; exactly one user.name lookup per import; stale sweeps equal half of the test's already-computed expected import commits (12 for N=3000 today, one per CREATE chunk); single/direct writes retain their existing lookup/sweep behavior.
negative_control: interactive writes remain one commit and one live author lookup per event; existing-ticket-only/empty batches do not gain stale-sweep work.
collateral_invariants: same event bytes/author fallback semantics, clean index, no lost/duplicate events, same warnings and provenance.
recovery: injected later-chunk commit failure resumes to all tickets exactly once.
ci_gate: integration pytest job and full Gerrit Verified gate.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] N=3000, 6,000 events, created/comment counts, exactly 24 commits, and >=10x assertions remain unchanged and pass.
- [ ] The integration oracle records exactly one git config user.name lookup for the import and stale-staging sweeps equal half of its existing expected-commit calculation (12 for the current locked N=3000/256 contract, one per CREATE chunk); both are deterministic, non-wall-clock assertions with no duplicated chunk-size literal.
- [ ] Interactive/direct writes retain live author lookup and stale-sweep behavior; cache/context and batch optimizations cannot leak across calls, threads/tasks, or sessions.
- [ ] Each defect-seeded mutation independently returns the held-out oracle to RED; the restored change is GREEN.
- [ ] Identical-host before/after evidence reports importer time and profiler call counts; timing is evidence, never a gate threshold.
- [ ] Import idempotency, crash-resume, rollback, per-event equivalence, atomic ticket-directory, clean-index, lint, typecheck, full pytest, LLM-Review, and Verified are green.
- [ ] No dependency, durability/public behavior, platform, Python-matrix, test, mutation, or coverage assurance is removed.

scope the author cache to one import call across all event-composition passes

retain the N=3000/6000-event/24-commit contract and pin deterministic author-read and CREATE-chunk sweep counts
